Application Fee
Application Fee
A non-refundable application fee is required for each application.
The non-refundable application fee (payable by bank draft, credit card, money order, personal check, or wire transfer) covers the cost of processing application materials. A credit card payment is accepted during online application submission only. Applications will not be processed until the application fee is paid.
Application fee waivers are granted to Fulbright Scholars and McNair Scholars. Proof of participation must be included with the application. Academic units may offer additional fee waivers. Contact the academic unit for more details.
